Convert a DER-encoded ECDSA signature to fixed-length raw r||s

Source: R/auth.R
der_ecdsa_to_raw.Rd

JOSE/JWT (RFC 7518) ES256 signatures are the raw concatenation of the r and s integers, each left-padded to the curve's coordinate length (32 bytes for P-256). OpenSSL, by contrast, emits ECDSA signatures as a DER SEQUENCE { INTEGER r, INTEGER s }. This unwraps that ASN.1 structure and repacks it into the fixed-length form the API expects.

Usage

der_ecdsa_to_raw(der, coord_len = 32L)

Arguments

der

Raw vector containing a DER-encoded ECDSA signature.

coord_len

Byte length of each coordinate (32 for P-256/ES256).

Value

A raw vector of length 2 * coord_len.
